knowledge_base_markdown:
# Knowledge Base

Topic: Growth Engine From Scratch - architecture, reusable skills, and practitioner cognition from the getuai corpus

Iteration: 10 architecture grounding trace contract

## Evidence Policy

Direct citations use `repo.md:line-line` from `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/`. Source IDs are mirrored in top-level benchmark citation arrays. Architecture claims prefer one direct file:line citation per interface row; digest source IDs are used only in the benchmark-answer citation arrays.

## Q1 - SEO/GEO Architecture

Converged architecture: UI/product shell -> SEO/GEO tool adapters -> AI/recommendation layer -> Core-owned identity, credentials, artifacts, schedules, approvals, ledgers, and kill-switch. Evidence: `getuai-seo.md:7-11`, `getuai-seo.md:93-97`, `getuai-api.md:7-28`, `growth-engine-legacy.md:43-50`, `growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`. The from-scratch subsystem should not let crawlers, rank tools, or publishers own tenant truth; they produce typed artifacts and recommendations that Core approves or stops.

Trace contract, each row is `input -> component -> state -> output`, with dependency and control point explicit:

| trace_id | input -> component -> state -> output | external dependency and failure handling | human/Core control | citation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| q1.trace1 | URL/site -> site-structure analyzer -> crawl/meta/internal-link state -> crawl artifact candidate | HTTP fetch can timeout or block; retry/log at adapter, not publisher | analyst can discard crawl artifact before generation | `getuai-plugin.md:11-14` |
| q1.trace2 | query/domain -> search, competitor, keyword tools -> SERP/competitor/keyword state -> intent map input | Google Search and Google Ads credentials can fail; adapter exposes failure rather than fabricating rankings | operator chooses canonical competitor/keyword set | `getuai-plugin.md:16-20` |
| q1.trace3 | term/company -> SEO campaign metrics -> campaign-rank state -> SEO ranking signal | SEO MCP/AI service must be running; connection failures block recommendations | campaign console review before action | `getuai-seo.md:101-106` |
| q1.trace4 | term/company URL -> LLMRush multi-model rank/sentiment -> model-rank/sentiment history -> GEO visibility signal | OpenAI, Deepseek, Anthropic, Gemini, and search fallback can drift or fail; token/request tracking makes the error observable | compare model disagreement before treating GEO as truth | `LLMRush.md:7-23` |
| q1.trace5 | category/product JSON -> content store -> product/category/metadata state -> publishable corpus | JSON/static store can be stale when schema/routes change; rebuild is required | content owner reviews product/category source before publish | `rankncompare.md:128-149` |
| q1.trace6 | stored pages/routes -> sitemap/robots publisher -> XML/txt artifacts -> crawler discovery surface | sitemap generation only supports search indexing; it is not a GEO evaluator | publish is allowed only after corpus review | `rankncompare.md:53-56` |
| q1.trace7 | proposed publish/check/write -> Core approval, ledger, kill-switch -> approved/stopped action state -> audit trail | Core-owned schedules/credentials prevent tool-local cron or token drift | explicit approval, override, and kill-switch | `growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88` |

Convergence: `getuai-seo` and `getuai-plugin` converge on UI/MCP/AI read adapters, `rankncompare` contributes the content store and sitemap publisher, `LLMRush` adds the GEO evaluator, and `growth-engine-legacy` supplies the Core control boundary. Disagreement: `getuai-seo` packages SEO as a three-service product (`getuai-seo.md:7-11`), `rankncompare` is a static publisher/content store rather than a rank sensor (`rankncompare.md:53-56`), and `growth-engine-legacy` insists browser-facing identity and platform facts stay in Core (`growth-engine-legacy.md:43-50`). Recommendation: keep adapters thin, store artifacts centrally, treat sitemap output as indexing support, and require Core approval/kill-switch for writes.

## Q2 - Content Writing Architecture

Architecture: campaign/entity facts -> ideation -> outline -> draft -> edit/review -> publish -> post-publish learning. `getuai-email-2.0` provides the concrete path: campaign CRUD, recipient import, SMTP CRUD/test, batch create, AI generate, review, send (`getuai-email-2.0.md:70-73`, `getuai-email-2.0.md:91-118`). Load-bearing choices are prompt/style variables, recipient schema, SMTP test, human review, and shared API artifact/session storage (`getuai-api.md:24-40`). Stylistic choices are table UI, template file format, and frontend stack.

| trace_id | input -> component -> state -> output | LLM role and review hook | load-bearing vs stylistic | citation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| q2.trace1 | campaign fields/style variables -> prompt-template form -> reusable prompt state -> ideation and outline contract | LLM none yet; human injects style guide and variables | load-bearing: placeholders define personalization contract | `getuai-email-2.0.md:91-94` |
| q2.trace2 | CSV recipient fields -> import service -> recipient records -> personalization input | LLM none; human/schema review catches bad CSV | load-bearing: `email,first_name,last_name,company,position` schema | `getuai-email-2.0.md:101-104` |
| q2.trace3 | batch + prompt + recipient -> AI generator -> generated email rows -> draft output | LLM generator; batch remains inspectable before send | load-bearing: recipient grounding and batch association | `getuai-email-2.0.md:111-114` |
| q2.trace4 | generated emails -> review grid -> approved content state -> sendable batch | LLM output becomes critic target; human review is mandatory | load-bearing: review before outbound side effect | `getuai-email-2.0.md:111-118` |
| q2.trace5 | SMTP account + approved batch -> SMTP test/send -> sent/failed status -> publish outcome | LLM none; SMTP test gates publishing | stylistic: UI tab layout; load-bearing: tested SMTP account | `getuai-email-2.0.md:96-99` |
| q2.trace6 | image/text/company artifacts -> API store -> session-scoped content -> post-publish input | LLM can consume artifacts later; API owns storage | load-bearing: artifact/session persistence across layers | `getuai-api.md:24-40` |
| q2.trace7 | factual question -> retrieval-grounded copy -> cited answer -> hallucination guard | LLM generator plus retrieval grounding; reviewer checks citations | load-bearing: citation-bearing answer for factual claims | `reddit-scount.md:233-239` |

Convergence: the mature pattern is not "agent writes copy"; it is structured facts and style guide injection before generation, human review before side effects, and persisted artifacts after publish. Disagreement: `gmi-prototype` shows local media generation with `generated_videos/`, which is useful for exploration but fails the shared artifact contract (`gmi-prototype.md:14`, `gmi-prototype.md:50`). Recommendation: keep prompt template, recipient schema, review, and publish status in the product path; defer rich media and multilingual register systems until the artifact store and review gate exist.

## Q3 - Ads Architecture

Architecture: campaign feed -> bidding/budget/targeting -> reporting -> attribution -> optimization. `getuai-ads` shows the UI/MCP/AI product and credential dependencies (`getuai-ads.md:7-11`, `getuai-ads.md:24-28`). `getu_ads_v2` is the agent-safe Google Ads adapter: stdin/file JSON, `exec run`, compact `ResultEnvelope`, and 38 operations (`getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`, `getu_ads_v2.md:1010-1017`). Platform SDKs and mutations stay platform-bound; ResultEnvelope, attribution events, reporting lake, anomaly/pacing checks, and kill criteria are platform-agnostic. `getuai-ads-data` supplies cross-platform campaign/conversion tables (`getuai-ads-data.md:216-250`). `attribution_v2` supplies browser SDK -> ingress/consumer -> Pub/Sub -> events/leads/scores (`attribution_v2.md:13-16`).

Trace contract, each row terminates in a direct file:line anchor:

| trace_id | input -> component -> state -> output | boundary and failure handling | human/Core control | citation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| q3.trace1 | credentials + campaign brief -> Ads UI/MCP/AI workbench -> campaign feed and recommendations -> operator plan | Google Ads credentials and DeepSeek API keys are external dependencies; missing env blocks the workbench | operator reviews recommendations before mutation | `getuai-ads.md:7-28` |
| q3.trace2 | operation JSON via stdin/file -> google-ads-cli `exec run` -> ResultEnvelope state -> agent-readable success/errors | platform-bound Google Ads code lives behind one CLI envelope; failures return `success:false` and nonzero exit | automation must branch on envelope, not stdout prose | `getu_ads_v2.md:9-67` |
| q3.trace3 | campaign/adgroup/keyword/RSA/budget payload -> 38 Google Ads operations -> campaign tree state -> mutation/list result | campaigns, ad groups, keywords, RSA creatives, targeting, budgets are Google-bound resources | write ops require approval and idempotent replay plan | `getu_ads_v2.md:1010-1017` |
| q3.trace4 | date range/GAQL -> reporting operations -> campaign/ad/search-term metrics -> optimization input | reporting is platform-bound at query time but platform-agnostic after envelope normalization | analyst inspects deltas before scale/kill decision | `getu_ads_v2.md:1048-1123` |
| q3.trace5 | campaign budget and geo/lang target -> budget/criteria operations -> pacing/targeting state -> bid or budget recommendation | pacing is a guardrail around spend, not autonomous spend authority | budget mutation is blocked until Core action approval | `getu_ads_v2.md:1131-1149` |
| q3.trace6 | SDK event + UTM + user/session -> attribution ingress/consumer -> event-table state -> conversion/lead score | browser SDK, GCP Pub/Sub, dual MySQL routing, and session rotation are failure points | lost attribution freezes optimization until identity path is fixed | `attribution_v2.md:13-16` |
| q3.trace7 | Google/Meta/TikTok rows -> ads data platform -> campaign/conversion data model -> trend/anomaly candidate | multi-platform storage is shared; platform collectors remain isolated | anomalous trend produces recommendation, not direct spend | `getuai-ads-data.md:216-250` |
| q3.trace8 | budget/targeting recommendation -> read/write approval boundary -> blocked or approved action -> action log | platform-agnostic action ledger guards platform-bound mutation | human-in-loop approval and rollback note | `lawyer_marketing.md:248-269` |
| q3.trace9 | unsafe write, lost attribution, or envelope error -> Core kill-switch -> freeze/pause/reduce state -> audited stop | Core-owned credentials, schedules, ledgers make unhealthy exits distinguishable from terminal stops | kill criteria override optimizer | `growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88` |

Data model: campaigns/ad groups/keywords/RSAs/budgets/criteria live in the Google Ads adapter (`getu_ads_v2.md:1010-1017`); cross-platform campaign, account, and conversion rows live in the data platform (`getuai-ads-data.md:216-250`); conversion events/leads/scores come from attribution (`attribution_v2.md:13-16`). Bidding and budget pacing are implemented as platform operations wrapped by the CLI (`getu_ads_v2.md:1131-1149`), while anomaly detection is a platform-agnostic read-side concern over trend/conversion data (`getuai-ads-data.md:216-250`). Disagreement: `getuai-ads` is a three-layer app, `getu_ads_v2` is a standalone skill/CLI, and `attribution_v2` is a production attribution service. Recommendation: keep platform writes behind skill envelopes, make attribution and reporting shared read models, and let Core own approval, ledgers, and kill-switches.

## Q4 - Social Architecture

Architecture: listen, post, schedule, engage, monitor as platform adapters behind a Gateway-style control plane, not a fake universal adapter. Reddit listening/topic selection: `reddit-scount.md:108-181`. YouTube search adapter: `youtube-api-demo.md:48-54`. X post/reply/search: `openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422`. OpenClaw multi-channel Gateway: `openclaw-marketing.md:132-158`. Credit/rate monitoring: `x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`, `x-api-credit-monitor.md:72-104`. Moderation gate: `openclaw-marketing.md:122-126`.

| trace_id | input -> component -> state -> output | platform difference and failure handling | moderation/control | citation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| q4.trace1 | company URL -> Reddit analysis -> keywords/pain/competitors/subreddits -> listen state | Reddit uses pain/subreddit discovery, not generic social search | analyst selects topics before outreach | `reddit-scount.md:108-139` |
| q4.trace2 | analysis + keyword/competitor index -> Reddit discovery -> posts/comments -> engagement cache | keyword rotation and comment fetch are Reddit-bound; SteadyAPI failure is isolated | human selects opportunities | `reddit-scount.md:141-181` |
| q4.trace3 | query + maxResults -> YouTube adapter -> video list -> monitor candidates | YouTube uses search result count and API quota; it is monitor-only here | no posting abstraction inferred | `youtube-api-demo.md:48-54` |
| q4.trace4 | text/post_id/query/media -> X skill -> platform JSON or side effect -> post/reply/search output | X tone, length, media, and reply semantics stay in X adapter | approval needed before public post/reply | `openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422` |
| q4.trace5 | channel message -> Gateway adapter -> routed session/inbox -> engage surface | Gateway unifies routing/session, not every platform's content semantics | channel policies decide allowed surfaces | `openclaw-marketing.md:132-158` |
| q4.trace6 | daily schedule + Chrome session + threshold -> launchd credit monitor -> heartbeat/alert state -> quota output | X credit balance and Chrome session can expire; Lark alert makes failure visible | ops can relogin or pause X automation | `x-api-credit-monitor.md:72-104` |
| q4.trace7 | generated reply -> DM allowlist policy -> allow/deny state -> moderated automation | moderation sits before outward automation; allowlist prevents broad unsolicited DMs | allowlist/deny gate | `openclaw-marketing.md:122-126` |

Convergence: the shared layer is Gateway/session/routing/observability; the skill layer remains per-platform for Reddit discovery, YouTube monitoring, X posting, and Slack/channel actions. Disagreement: OpenClaw's Gateway suggests a multi-channel control plane, while `reddit-scount`, `youtube-api-demo`, and `x-api-credit-monitor` remain narrow adapters. Recommendation: use a Gateway to prevent N x M orchestration sprawl, but encode platform differences as parameters and per-adapter policies rather than pretending platforms are interchangeable.

## Q9-Q12 Cognition

SEO/GEO models: topical authority worked in `rankncompare.md:128-187` and failed in `getuai-2.0.md:19-42`; intent mapping worked in `getuai-plugin.md:11-20` and fails when `rankncompare.md:53-56` is used as discovery; E-E-A-T worked in `lawyer_marketing.md:291-317` and fails without industry packs (`growth-engine.md:8`, `growth-engine.md:27`); GEO-vs-SEO worked in `LLMRush.md:7-14` and fails if sitemap is treated as GEO (`rankncompare.md:134-149`); velocity-vs-depth worked in `getuai-seo.md:101-106` and failed in docs-without-runtime (`growth-engine-legacy.md:16-22`). Anti-patterns: static publisher as GEO evaluator; importing legacy scaffolding instead of rebuilding contracts.

Content frames: user journey worked in `getuai-email-2.0.md:70-118` and failed in local-only `gmi-prototype.md:7-54`; portfolio theory worked in OpenClaw media/summarizer skills (`openclaw-marketing.md:5104-5152`, `openclaw-marketing.md:6656-6716`) and fails if email is the whole system; distribution-over-production worked in reviewed SMTP send and failed in local `generated_videos/`; ROI windows worked in `LLMRush.md:7-23` and failed in `getuai-2.0.md:19-42`; brand voice worked with placeholders/review and failed with free-form prototype prompts. Hooks: Q2 prompt/style injection and Q6 prompt-template/cited-copy skills.

Ads models: LTV/CAC worked in `lawyer_marketing.md:291-304` plus `getu_ads_v2.md:1048-1064` and fails on missing identity (`attribution_v2.md:117-119`); pacing worked in `getu_ads_v2.md:1131-1149` and breaks on credentials (`getuai-ads.md:24-28`); creative fatigue worked with RSA/ad reports (`getu_ads_v2.md:630-704`, `getu_ads_v2.md:1066-1086`) and fails in aggregate-only data; attribution paradox worked in `attribution_v2.md:13-23` and breaks on cookies/session rotation (`attribution_v2.md:151-186`); kill-vs-scale worked in read/write gates (`lawyer_marketing.md:248-269`) and fails when engines own writes (`growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`).

Social models: platform game theory worked in Reddit-specific discovery (`reddit-scount.md:108-181`) and is contested by generic Gateway need for policy (`openclaw-marketing.md:122-158`); algorithm preference worked in YouTube/X primitives (`youtube-api-demo.md:48-54`, `openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422`) and fails if search-only is treated as engagement; community fit worked in subreddit-first discovery and fails with raw xurl posting; viral mechanics require post/reply/media but fail without monitoring; automation visibility cost is controlled by allowlists and credit monitor (`openclaw-marketing.md:122-126`, `x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`). Anti-patterns: one prompt for every platform; posting without quota/credit visibility.

## Q13 - Shared Foundations

Shared foundations: identity/session (`growth-engine-legacy.md:43-50`, `getuai-api.md:23-37`), credentials/secrets (`growth-engine-legacy.md:64-88`, `getuai-ads.md:21-28`, `x-api-credit-monitor.md:12-18`), data/artifacts (`getuai-api.md:24-42`, `rankncompare.md:49-56`, `attribution_v2.md:13-16`), schedules/queues (`growth-engine-legacy.md:64-88`, `x-api-credit-monitor.md:82-93`), observability (`growth-engine-legacy.md:64-70`, `LLMRush.md:19-23`), LLM gateway (`getuai-seo.md:78-91`, `getuai-email-2.0.md:111-114`), human-in-loop console (`growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`, `lawyer_marketing.md:248-269`), repo-template governance (`optiminds-repo-template.md:9-63`). Decision rule: share tenant trust, credentials, schedules, ledgers, observability, LLM routing, and approval; isolate schemas, external APIs, ranking logic, tone, and domain kill criteria.

Social is listen/post/schedule/engage/monitor through per-platform adapters behind Gateway routing, with rate/credit monitoring and moderation gates before outward automation.
